summary: Saint Martin shared his cloak with a beggar and became a witness to charity. He remains a model of mercy and humble service.
antiphon_text: Let us remember Saint Martin of Tours as a faithful witness to the love and mercy of Christ.
prayer_text: Lord God, through the life of Saint Martin of Tours, strengthen us to follow your path with courage and charity. Grant us the grace to bear faithful witness in our own time. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
